name: retroplug2-ui
description: RetroPlug workspace root: the JS build toolchain (esbuild) and the runtime deps bundled into the UI.

scripts.validate:greenfield: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-greenfield-clap retroplug-greenfield-vst3 && RETROPLUG_CLAP_NAME=retroplug-greenfield RETROPLUG_VST3_NAME=retroplug-greenfield tools/validate-plugins.sh
scripts.reaper:mgb-smoke-greenfield-author: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-greenfield-vst3 && node tools/author-greenfield-rplg.js && RETROPLUG_VST3_NAME=retroplug-greenfield tools/run-reaper-author.sh examples/reaper/mgb_smoke_greenfield.rpp build tools/reaper-mgb-greenfield-author.lua build/mgb_greenfield.rplg
scripts.reaper:mgb-smoke-greenfield: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-greenfield-vst3 && node tools/author-greenfield-rplg.js && RETROPLUG_VST3_NAME=retroplug-greenfield tools/run-reaper-render.sh examples/reaper/mgb_smoke_greenfield.rpp build/mgb_greenfield.rplg
scripts.reaper:analyze-lsdj-sync: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-cli cli-regenerate && node scripts/run-ts-tests.js cli gb/lsdj/sync_pattern && tools/reaper-stage.sh /tmp/lsdj-sync-pattern_sys0.wav /tmp/lsdj-sync-pattern_sys1.wav
scripts.reaper:analyze-smoke-greenfield: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-greenfield-cli retroplug-greenfield-example-session && RETROPLUG_USER_CONFIG_DIR=/tmp/gfcli-analyze build/bin/retroplug-greenfield-cli build/greenfield-cli/analyze-mgb.js /tmp/cli-smoke-greenfield.wav && tools/reaper-stage.sh /tmp/cli-smoke-greenfield.wav
scripts.reaper:analyze-lsdj-sync-greenfield: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-greenfield-cli retroplug-greenfield-example-session && RETROPLUG_USER_CONFIG_DIR=/tmp/gfcli-analyze build/bin/retroplug-greenfield-cli build/greenfield-cli/analyze-lsdj-sync.js ../resources/roms/lsdj/lsdj9_4_2.gb /tmp/lsdj-sync-pattern-greenfield && tools/reaper-stage.sh /tmp/lsdj-sync-pattern-greenfield_sys0.wav /tmp/lsdj-sync-pattern-greenfield_sys1.wav
